use_case: Data pipeline maintenance: setting the S3 lifecycle retention on nightly warehouse export jobs, with one exception for exports that write under the ledger prefix.
situation: The user said every export job should get expire_days: 30. Much later, they said anything writing under the ledger/ prefix must stay at 2555 days. One of the remaining jobs, payouts_daily.yaml, writes to s3://brightfold-archive/ledger/payouts/, which is easy to miss because its name doesn't say "ledger".
must_keep: The general rule (expire_days: 30 on all export jobs), the user's later exception (ledger/ prefix exports stay at 2555 days), and the grep output showing that payouts_daily.yaml writes to the ledger/ prefix.
may_drop: Build and test logs, the git log, the already-applied patches for orders and sessions, the outdated README retention table, and the assistant progress summary.
why_judges_fail: The progress summary shares the most words with the goal and lists payouts_daily as plain remaining work, and the README has a different, outdated ledger retention value. A judge might keep those and drop the short exception or the grep line that brings payouts_daily under the exception, so the agent would set payouts to 30 days.
